# Game Idea: **Canvas Escape**

- **Genre:** Arcade / Endless runner
- **Core mechanic:** The player controls a small ship that automatically moves forward across a horizontally scrolling starfield. Tap / click to boost upward; gravity pulls the ship down.
- **Obstacles:** Randomly generated asteroid fields and laser barriers appear from the right. Colliding with any obstacle ends the game.
- **Lose condition:** Ship hits an asteroid/laser or falls off the bottom of the canvas.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible; distance traveled is the score.

*All visuals and physics can be implemented using plain HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript.*

1: // Minimal Canvas Escape game
2: // Assumes an existing <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = 400;
7:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = 600;
8: 
9:   // Sound effects (embedded short wav data)
10:   const boostSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAACAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAg');
11:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRhYAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YRAAAAD///8AAAA=');
12: 
13:   // Ship state
14:   const ship = {
15:     x: 50,
16:     y: HEIGHT / 2,
17:     w: 20,
18:     h: 20,
19:     vy: 0,
20:     radius: 10,
21:   };
22:   const GRAVITY = 0.4;
23:   const BOOST = -8;
24: 
25:   // Background stars
26:   const stars = [];
27:   const STAR_COUNT = 80;
28:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
29:     stars.push({
30:       x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
31:       y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
32:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
33:       speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3,
34:     });
35:   }
36: 
37:   // Obstacles (asteroids)
38:   const obstacles = [];
39:   const OBSTACLE_SPACING = 1200; // ms
40:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 3;
41:   let lastObstacle = 0;
42: 
43:   let score = 0;
44:   let startTime = null;
45:   let running = true;
46: 
47:   function reset() {
48:     ship.y = HEIGHT / 2;
49:     ship.vy = 0;
50:     obstacles.length = 0;
51:     lastObstacle = 0;
52:     score = 0;
53:     startTime = null;
54:     running = true;
55:     requestAnimationFrame(frame);
56:   }
57: 
58:   function addObstacle() {
59:     // Random size, vertical position, and rotation
60:     const h = 30 + Math.random() * 70;
61:     const y = Math.random() * (HEIGHT - h);
62:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
63:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1; // radians per frame
64:     obstacles.push({ x: WIDTH, y, w: 20, h, angle, rotSpeed });
65:   }
66: 
67:   function update(dt) {
68:     // Ship physics
69:     ship.vy += GRAVITY;
70:     ship.y += ship.vy;
71: 
72:     // Bounds check (top only, bottom triggers game over)
73:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0;
74:     if (ship.y + ship.h > HEIGHT) {
75:       running = false;
76:       crashSound.currentTime = 0;
77:       crashSound.play();
78:     }
79: 
80:     // Move background stars for parallax effect
81:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
82:       const s = stars[i];
83:       s.x -= s.speed;
84:       if (s.x < 0) {
85:         s.x = WIDTH;
86:         s.y = Math.random() * HEIGHT;
87:       }
88:     }
89: 
90:     // Obstacles movement
91:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
92:       const o = obstacles[i];
93:       o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED;
94:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
95:     }
96: 
97:     // Collision detection
98:     for (const o of obstacles) {
99:       if (
100:         ship.x < o.x + o.w &&
101:         ship.x + ship.w > o.x &&
102:         ship.y < o.y + o.h &&
103:         ship.y + ship.h > o.y
104:       ) {
105:         running = false;
106:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
107:         crashSound.play();
108:         break;
109:       }
110:     }
111: 
112:     // Add new obstacles
113:     if (Date.now() - lastObstacle > OBSTACLE_SPACING) {
114:       addObstacle();
115:       lastObstacle = Date.now();
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Score is elapsed time in seconds
119:     if (running) {
120:       const now = Date.now();
121:       if (!startTime) startTime = now;
122:       score = ((now - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
123:     }
124:   }
125: 
126:   function draw() {
127:     // Background gradient
128:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
129:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
130:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
131:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
132:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
133: 
134:     // Draw stars (parallax)
135:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
136:     for (const s of stars) {
137:       ctx.beginPath();
138:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
139:       ctx.fill();
140:     }
141: 
142:     // Draw ship (triangle)
143:     ctx.save();
144:     ctx.translate(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
145:     ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
146:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
147:     ctx.beginPath();
148:     ctx.moveTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius);
149:     ctx.lineTo(ship.radius, 0);
150:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius);
151:     ctx.closePath();
152:     ctx.fill();
153:     ctx.restore();
154: 
155:     // Draw obstacles (rotating asteroids)
156:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a'; // brownish asteroid
157:     for (const o of obstacles) {
158:       ctx.save();
159:       ctx.translate(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2);
160:       o.angle += o.rotSpeed;
161:       ctx.rotate(o.angle);
162:       ctx.fillRect(-o.w / 2, -o.h / 2, o.w, o.h);
163:       ctx.restore();
164:     }
165: 
166:     // Draw score
167:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
169:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
170: 
171:     // Game over overlay
172:     if (!running) {
173:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
174:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
175:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
176:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
177:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
178:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 20);
179:       ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
180:       ctx.fillText('Click to restart', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
181:     }
182:   }
183: 
184:   function frame(timestamp) {
185:     if (!running) {
186:       draw();
187:       return; // stop loop
188:     }
189:     update(timestamp);
190:     draw();
191:     requestAnimationFrame(frame);
192:   }
193: 
194:   // Input – boost ship upward on any click/tap
195:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
196:     ship.vy = BOOST;
197:     boostSound.currentTime = 0;
198:     boostSound.play();
199:   });
200:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
201:     e.preventDefault();
202:     ship.vy = BOOST;
203:     boostSound.currentTime = 0;
204:     boostSound.play();
205:   });
206: 
207:   // Restart on click after game over
208:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
209:     if (!running) reset();
210:   });
211: 
212:   // Start the game
213:   requestAnimationFrame(frame);
214: })();

(End of file - total 214 lines)
</content>
